content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ACTIVE PAGE: High GPU queue and failed scale-ups in aws-ap-southeast-1. Autoscaler returning quota errors. Impacting inference throughput for Dedicated pools. /incident bridge started.

sara w: seeing a huge backlog on the inference queue, +1800 waiting requests in the last 5m. latency p95 up to ~4s -> 20s for some customers. logs show: `QuotaExceeded` from cloud provider during node provisioning.

mike (oncall infra): ack. grabbing oncall. are these new instance types or usual g4dn/tn1 requests?

devon (eng-runtime): standard p4d/GPU flavor for Dedicated. autoscaler attempted 8 scale-up attempts, each failing with the same error. sample from autoscaler:
```
2026-03-15T12:02:10Z autoscaler: scaleUp failed: CreateInstances API error: quotaExceeded: "GPUs per region quota exceeded (requested 8, available 0)"
```

rana (sre): confirming cloud console shows GPUs used ~= hard cap for account in ap-southeast-1. No recent quota change from our side. Might be noisy neighbor or another team consuming. Opening a support ticket with provider now. ticket id: AWS#133742.

kevin (cust-success): customers flagged elevated 429s already. Two enterprise customers (AcmePay & DocuFlow) have reported timeouts on high-volume jobs. AcmePay is on Dedicated in that region.

mike (oncall infra): mitigation options:
- fallback routing: route non-Dedicated / low-priority jobs to eu-west1 temporarily
- admission control: drop/queue only low-priority requests, preserve gold tier
- try to provision smaller instances (1x GPU instead of 4x) to fit remaining quota
- request emergency quota bump (may take 1-6h)
Which is fastest to implement?

sara w: fallback routing is fastest — we already have cross-region routing in the router. Can we flip a policy to send non- dedicated / non-SLA requests to eu-west1? Needs a quick config change in router service.

devon (eng-runtime): I can push a canary rule to the router in 3-5 minutes: add header-based bypass for gold customers so they stay local, everything else -> eu-west1. Also can enable packing to move workloads onto half-sized instances where possible.

mike (oncall infra): mike -> will open bridge with cloud provider escalation. rana please keep updating ticket. devon go ahead with router rule and packing. kevin coordinate customer comms: send hold message to AcmePay.

rana (sre): provider responded: "We observe account-level GPU quota at limit in ap-southeast-1. We've escalated to quota team; ETA unknown." Adding our usage snapshot in ticket.

deploy-bot: scheduled change: router.canary.add-rule by devon scheduled at 2026-03-15T12:07:00Z. /deploy logs attached: commit d3f9c7

devon (eng-runtime): pushed canary rule, rolling 10% -> 100% over 5m. Pack/resize script also triggered to prefer 1x GPU nodes where possible. Logs:
```
2026-03-15T12:08:20Z router: canary 10% applied
2026-03-15T12:10:01Z packing: started resizing pods to 1x-GPU variants
```

sara w: immediate improvement visible: queue down from 1800 -> 900 in 6m. p95 now back to ~6s for most customers. gold traffic unaffected. still seeing some CreateInstances quota errors for Dedicated jobs pinned to ap-southeast-1.

kevin (cust-success): AcmePay on Dedicated — they want SLA status. Sending interim note: "We've detected infrastructure contention in ap-southeast-1 affecting some Dedicated jobs. We're routing non-critical work to other regions and prioritizing your traffic. Will update within 30m." :email:

mike (oncall infra): plan B if quota bump doesn't come quickly: migrate select Dedicated pools for impacted customers to eu-west1 (requires coordination with sales/legal for data locality). Devon/rana estimate time?

devon (eng-runtime): cold migration of a Dedicated pool ~25-40m, hot fallback via routing ~10-15m (but needs certificates/route setup we can automate). We should avoid full migrations unless provider ETA is >1h.

rana (sre): provider updated ticket: "Quota increase request pending; current ETA 2-4h. We can expedite but need justification." I'll push for urgency citing production impact and customers reporting timeouts.

sara w: tracking customer impact: ~3% global request failure rate, ~12% of Dedicated customers in ap-southeast-1 seeing degraded throughput. Logging flagged one high-prio inference job retried 5x then failed — costing tokens and client errors. Capture these for RCA.

kevin (cust-success): AcmePay acknowledged the note and asked for expected ETA. I told them ~1h for stabilization via routing; flagged for follow-up if migration needed.

mike (oncall infra): current mitigations summary:
- router canary -> eu-west1 for non-gold: deployed
- packing to smaller instances: in progress
- emergency quota ticket opened and escalated
- customer comms sent
Next: monitor for 30m. If queue not <300 and quota not increased, start migrations for top 2 impacted Dedicated pools. Assign postmortem to devon + rana.

devon (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem. creating jira INF-5021 and adding runbooks + logs.

rana (sre): updating ticket and raising pager to cloud provider support lead.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Status update logged. Bridge remains open. Postmortem required. Reminder: add eval-suite checks for region saturation in Optimize.

mike (oncall infra): taking lateral handoff to afternoon oncall. mike -> rana -> devon for follow-ups. tagging ops rotation. :eyes:

kevin (cust-success): will follow up with affected customers and escalate any contractual concerns.

sara w: thanks team. monitoring dashboard shows gradual steady state. will update thread in 20m with final numbers. :thumbsup:
